name: @octocodeai/octocode-benchmark
description: Benchmark suites for Octocode tools and engine behavior.

scripts.build: echo 'Source-only benchmark package; no build artifacts required'
scripts.lint: python3 -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" compare/bin/*.py skills/octocode-benchmark/scripts/*.py && bash -n compare/bin/octoc && bash -n compare/bin/octoc-npm && bash -n compare/bin/ghc && bash -n compare/bin/ghm && bash -n compare/bin/rtkm && bash -n skills/octocode-benchmark/scripts/check-prereqs.sh && bash -n skills/octocode-benchmark/scripts/measure.sh
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
